name: title-to-new-game
description: From the title boot point (T = 1250): press Circle three times, one second apart, to pick the title menu's first entry (New Game; with no memory card it is where the cursor starts). Repeated so that a press made while the menu is still fading in does not matter; presses after New Game fall on the fade-out and the opening movie, which take no input. 240 frames. A hypothesis about the game's menu, judged only by what follows (#74); no FF7 address is used.
